problem: The company was restructuring and struggling, and its CEO criticised the programme.
title: Best Buy ends its Results Only Work Environment for corporate staff
context: Best Buy launched ROWE, which let corporate employees work anywhere on their own schedules if results were met, in 2005.
decision_made: End ROWE for headquarters employees, with managers keeping some discretion for flexibility.
action_taken: Announced in March 2013, days after Yahoo's remote work reversal.
observed_outcome: The programme ended with no plan to reinstate it. The sources used contain no measured effects.
lessons: Flexible work programmes can be dropped during a turnaround when leaders prioritise presence.
limitations: Bloomberg's article was paywalled, so details come from excerpts. The CEO's quote that ROWE was fundamentally flawed is from a secondary account.

claims.claim_text: Best Buy said it would end its Results-Only Work Environment for corporate employees.
There were no plans to reinstate ROWE, though managers kept some discretion to allow flexibility.
